newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds lower, demand slow.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds lower, demand slow.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were mostly lower on Tuesday as the market reopened after the long holiday weekend, but demand was slow.
Brokers said the small amount of rain recently coupled with warmer weather has led to more silage being cut than at first thought.
"Compounders are almost suicidal because the silage which we thought would not be in the fields in April is now being cut," said one broker.
High protein soymeal ex-mill was three to five stg down ex-mill while store was three stg lower.
Rapemeal and corn gluten feed pellets were one stg down while sunflower meal and pellets were unchanged.
